# Simple Block Breaker
### Simple vanilla-friendly block breaker and placer for 1.21.4
[![build](https://github.com/CanadianBaconBoi/SimpleBlockBreaker/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://github.com/CanadianBaconBoi/SimpleBlockBreaker/actions/workflows/build.yml)
![Mod loader: Forge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mod%20Loader-Forge-1976d2?logo=data:image/png;base64,)
[![Curseforge](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/1227573.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/simple-block-breaker)

## Install
This mod requires [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/fabric-language-kotlin) and [Fabric API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api)

Latest release can be downloaded [Here](https://github.com/CanadianBaconBoi/SimpleBlockBreaker/releases/latest)

## Build
Download either a [source tarball](https://github.com/CanadianBaconBoi/SimpleBlockBreaker/archive/refs/heads/master.zip) and extract it or clone the repository
```
git clone https://github.com/CanadianBaconBoi/SimpleBlockBreaker.git
```

Linux:
```shell
$ cd SimpleBlockBreaker
$ chmod +x ./gradlew
$ ./gradlew build
```

Windows (cmd):
```shell
cd SimpleBlockBreaker
./gradlew.bat build
```
